1. NATURE DAY — If the field is wet, we will meet in the hall. Check the message board before leaving your classroom.

2. Hi Jo, if it rains, bring your umbrella. We will walk from the bus stop to the school entrance. Sam

3. TRIP UPDATE — We will not visit the lake if there is a thunderstorm. The teacher will choose an indoor activity instead.

4. WEATHER BOARD — If it is cloudy, the photo activity will still take place. Rain may move it inside.

5. Hi Dad, if we finish early, I will call you. Please wait for my call before coming to collect me. Eva

6. NATURE TABLE — If you borrow a guidebook, return it before leaving. Every group needs a turn.
